verdict.rationale: Fern's changelog mentions a self-hosted container that serves docs pages, which is Fern's own way to run docs on your own infrastructure. It is a server image, not an exported static bundle, and only a passing changelog mention supports it. Missing for 10: a documented static-site export or build command, evidence the output can be hosted on any static host, documentation of the self-hosting setup and its plan availability, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my entire docs site as a static bundle and host it anywhere, so my content is never locked in

citations.quote: A self-hosted container can now resolve environment variables in the pages it serves, on each request... so one image serves deployments that differ only in those values.
